title: The platform took part in Warsaw’s conference on memory
author: Andrei Arkhipenka
excerpt: An international conference at the Free Belarus Museum, 8–9 October 2026. Andrei Arkhipenka took part in one of its panels with a presentation on Taiwan’s memory culture.
body:
On 8–9 October 2026, Warsaw hosted the international conference “After Totalitarianism: Museum, Memory and the Belarusian Perspective”, organised by the Free Belarus Museum.

Andrei Arkhipenka, founder of Belarus–Taiwan & East Asia Platform and a researcher, took part in one of the panels at this conference. His presentation focused on Taiwan’s memory culture.

The conference brought museum professionals and researchers together to discuss remembrance of repression and approaches to authoritarian legacies. The platform’s participation brought a Taiwanese perspective into this international discussion.
